paragraphs.text: Single-choice board in the DeepSeek Harness chat: pick one of several answers, images or sounds
# dsh-choice
A single-choice board inside the DeepSeek Harness chat, next to the built-in `ask_user_question`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Every option is **text**, an **image** or a **sound**. The card is posted as a normal chat
row, the

user presses the check icon on one row, and the choice comes back as an ordinary
chat message that s
tarts the next turn.
## Behaviour

- **one pick per board** — the check button on the chosen row; other rows become inert;
- **«none of

these»** — a trailing row with its label from `noneLabel`;
- sounds and image previews stay usable

after the pick;
- **non-blocking** — the tool returns immediately, unlike `ask_user_question`, which

board:
`human interaction is unavailable while the calling agent is owned by another live agent…`.

All visible text (title, subtitle, option titles and descriptions, `noneLabel`) comes from
the agent
, in the language of the conversation.
## Card

Rows: a 52 px preview (image thumbnail or ▶ button), the title and description, and the
round check

button on the right. Clicking an image opens a lightbox; pressing ▶ plays the
sound with a plain `Au

dio` object, so there is no extra UI. A pick replaces the drafts
carefully: the composer keeps its t
ext, the choice is sent as its own message.
## Options
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Local files are copied into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-choice\media` and served over loopback.
## Bridge
| Method | Path | Purpose |

| `GET` | `/status` | port and media counter |
| `GET` | `/media/<file>` | served image or audio |
|

`POST` | `/attach` | copy a local file and return its URL |
| `GET` | `/settings` | stored settings

(`language`) |
| `POST` | `/settings` | save `language`: `ru`, `en`, `zh` or `auto` |
## Settings

The plugin row config (`plugins.row.config`) holds one control: the interface language —
Русский, En

glish, 中文 or Авто. It is stored in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-choice\settings.json`
and applies to the card
and the form without a restart.
The language is resolved in this order:

1. the saved `language`, when it is `ru`, `en` or `zh`;
2. `auto` — the application language: `docum
nothing stored — `ru`.

All card text (title, subtitle, option titles and descriptions, `noneLabel`) comes from the
agent, i

n the language of the conversation; only the plugin's own labels — the pick, play
and open buttons a
nd the settings row — follow the language above.
## Languages

The interface speaks Russian, English and Chinese. The language comes from the
extension setting whe

n it is `ru`, `en` or `zh`; `auto` follows the application
language (`document.documentElement.lang`

, then `navigator.language`; `ru*` → ru,
`zh*` → zh, anything else → en); with nothing stored it is

`ru`. Change it in
**Plugins → Choice**; the value lives in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-choice\settings.json

`
and applies without a restart.

client half reloads with the page.
